mapper.select: SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , ROUND(t1.USD_WONBON_AEK * NVL(t1.JM_PER, 0) / 100, 2) AS usd_tuja , sonik.jm_sonik AS jm_sonik , sonik.pg_sonik AS pg_sonik , sonik.pg_premium AS pg_premium , sonik.put_premium AS put_premium , sonik.un_sonik AS un_sonik FROM SZT0IA_V t1 , SZM0IA ia , (SELECT ta.FUND_CD , SUM(NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK, 0)) AS jm_sonik , SUM(ta.JM_PG_SONIK) AS pg_sonik , SUM(ta.PUT_PG_PREMIUM) AS pg_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.PUT_BF_PREMIUM, 0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM, 0)) AS put_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_PG_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.PUT_PG_PREMIUM, 0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM, 0)) AS un_sonik FROM USPM_SONIK ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ta.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY ta.FUND_CD) sonik WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NVL(t1.DEL, 'N') = 'N' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND sonik.fund_cd(+) = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_nm , CASE WHEN t1.TRUSTEE LIKE '(%)' THEN t1.TRUSTEE ELSE '' END AS trustee , t1.JM_CD AS sym0yz_jm_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , ya.JM_NM AS sym0ya_jm_nm , ya.JM_NM AS jm_nm , ya.HANGSA_GA AS sym0ya_hangsa_ga , ya.HANGSA_GA AS hangsa_ga , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB = '1' THEN '주식합계 ' WHEN ya.JASAN_GB = 'A' THEN TO_CHAR(ya.LSY_YMD, '"만기 "mm"월 " dd"일계 "') WHEN ya.JASAN_GB = '5' THEN '예금' ELSE ya.JASAN_GB END AS lay_string , TO_CHAR(ya.LSY_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lsy_ymd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS jusu , NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS aek , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB = '5' THEN 0 ELSE t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK END AS tr_pyunga_aek , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , t1.IMP_JONGA AS imp_jonga , t1.IMP_VOLATILITY AS imp_volatility , t1.DELTA AS delta , t1.GAMMA AS gamma , t1.VEGA AS vega , t1.DELTA_RISK_VALUE AS delta_risk_value , t1.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE AS gamma_risk_value , t1.VEGA_RISK_VALUE AS vega_risk_value , NVL(t1.DELTA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(t1.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(t1.VEGA_RISK_VALUE, 0) AS risk_value , ya.JASAN_GB AS jasan_gb , COUNT(ya.JASAN_GB) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TRUSTEE, ya.JASAN_GB) AS jasan_count , ROUND((t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK / NULLIF(NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_AEK, 0), 0)) * 100 - 100, 2) AS sonik_ryul FROM SYM0YZ t1 , SZM0IA ia , SYM0YA ya WHERE 1 = 1 AND t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY 5 ASC , CASE WHEN ya.JASAN_GB = '1' THEN 2 WHEN ya.JASAN_GB = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 9 END ASC , 9 ASC , t1.JM_CD ASC
